Bob Onder addresses child protection and government shutdowns in recent tweets
L. E. Ferrer
Bob Onder, a U.S. politician and former Missouri state senator, published several posts on his Twitter account between July 27 and July 29, 2026. The tweets addressed topics ranging from personal tributes to political commentary.
On July 27, Onder posted a birthday message for Chloe Cole, stating: "Every birthday is a celebration - a reminder that every one of us is born with inherent dignity, immeasurable worth, and a future full of possibility. Today, on July 27, we wish @ChloeCole a very happy birthday. Chloe is one of the bravest young women I have ever met. Earlier https://t.co/WihCsX23LP".
The following day, July 28, Onder commented on partisan divisions in government shutdowns: "Democrats have weaponized the government before, causing the longest government shutdown in U.S. history. They will always put their destructive political agenda ahead of the American people, and we cannot allow them to continue getting away with it. I joined @AVPMikeFerguson on https://t.co/Qf5kJ42QFo".
On July 29, Onder highlighted an op-ed he wrote for The Daily Wire regarding child protection policies: "In honor of @ChloeCole’s birthday, I wrote a new op-ed for the @realDailyWire on the importance of protecting America’s children from irreversible harm. Check it out! https://t.co/USu1zBA0KW".
Onder has been known for his advocacy against gender transition procedures for minors and has previously collaborated with conservative media outlets such as The Daily Wire to promote these views. Chloe Cole is recognized as an activist who has spoken publicly about her experiences related to gender transition and subsequent detransitioning.
